from.ref: EN 10219-2:2006, outside corner profile for T <= 6 mm
from.note: A 4.75 mm (3/16 in) wall is not an EN 10219-2 size; the 200x100 outside size is. The radii follow the standard's rule for T <= 6 mm: outer radius 2 T, inner radius T. b is the 100 mm face (section x), h the 200 mm face (section y).
